tmp:1004: ha-neginah nifgemet — the blemishing of melody/song when Malkhut of holiness is in exile, explaining why cantors (chazanim) lack da'at, since melody derives from the prophetic source
tmp:1005: hanhagah — leadership/governance of the world, the functional aspect of Malkhut (kingship) that is blemished and turned to heresy when one without perfect faith presumes to lead
tmp:1006: hitlabshut ha-Kabbalah ba-halakhah — the enclothement of Kabbalah (razin d'razin) within Halakhah (razin), symbolizing God's weekday governance, the Lower Unification (yichuda tata'ah)
tmp:1009: ha-noten koach li-vchinat shalosh raglin — that which empowers the three 'legs' (festivals) aspect: the two kinds of tzedakah (weekday charity = present sun; Shabbat charity = future renewed sun of the World to Come)
tmp:1010: mizrach — East as a symbol for the GIVER of tzedakah, from 'from the east I will bring your seed' and 'sow for yourselves for tzedakah' (opposed to West = the poor recipient)
tmp:1012: chakhamim lehara — 'wise to do evil' (Jer. 4:22), evil cleverness identified with the primordial Serpent (nachash), in the secret of circumcision
tmp:1013: ha-nekudah ha-tachtonah shel temunat alef — the LOWER dot of the letter Alef's form, symbolizing demimah (silence/stillness), the chirik vowel, 'the earth is My footstool' (hadom)
tmp:1015: ashrei — 'praiseworthy' (Ps. 119:1) expounded as a term of histaklut (gazing), i.e., gazing upon the intellect (Yaakov ish tam) present in every thing
tmp:1016: stimat ha-einayim — the physical act of shutting/sealing the eyes tightly (even pressing with a finger) required to gaze upon the light of the ultimate purpose (takhlit)
tmp:1017: histaklut ha-zot — this particular gaze upon the takhlit (the all-good, all-one ultimate purpose), attainable only with completely closed eyes
tmp:1019: ein lo emunat chakhamim — the deficient state of lacking faith in the Sages, equated with the 'departure of the sages' and the pele ('wonder') of Isaiah 29:14; remedied by a vow
tmp:1024: bizyonot u-shefikhut damim — humiliations and 'bloodshed' (shaming that drains the face's blood) suffered before repentance, manifesting the hiding and turning-away of the face of the Name Ehyeh (EKY"H)
tmp:1025: hastarat ve-hachzarat pnei EKY"H — the hiding and turning-back of the 'face' of the divine Name Ehyeh from the sinner before teshuvah, experienced as disgrace and bloodshed
tmp:1029: meshaber ga'avato — the act of breaking one's own pride/arrogance, the measure of which determines the elevation of divine glory (kavod), linked to Mount Tabor
tmp:1030: ha'alaat ha-kavod — the elevation/raising of the divine glory, accomplished through Torah and proportional to the breaking of one's pride and attaining humility
tmp:1031: kol ha-dibburim she-medabrim be-Torah u-tefillah — all words spoken in Torah study and prayer, functioning as ha'alaat mayin nukvin (raising of the feminine waters) that bind one to God
tmp:1034: he'elah et ha-malkhut mi-bein ha-Sitra Achra — the act of raising Malkhut (fallen kingship) out from among the Other Side, effected through verbal confession ('death' / destruction of sixty cities)
tmp:1035: la itgalya — 'not revealed' (Sifra DiTzniuta on Ze'ir Anpin), the concealed/hidden (he'lem) dimension within humanly attainable wisdoms, their inner makif aspect
tmp:1037: ha-peh nishlam be-or gadol — the mouth/speech perfected with great light: through the delight of Shabbat eating (unlike weekday fasting) speech of peace is completed ('adabrah na shalom')
tmp:1038: havlei ha-goyim — the 'vanities of the nations' (Jer. 14:22, idolatry), identified as interruption/cessation of the breath (neshimah) that brings rain and wealth
tmp:1040: ha-peirot ha-gedelim ba-anafim — one's children as the 'fruits' growing on the soul-tree's branches (money/soul-light); the robber who takes the branch (money) takes the fruits (children's souls)
tmp:1041: 've-holakhti ivrim be-derekh lo yada'u' — the verse 'I will lead the blind by a way they knew not' (Isa. 42:16), signifying the tzaddik guiding the penitent onto the straight path (crossroads)
tmp:1042: ha-tzaddik horah lo derekh yashar — the tzaddik's act of instructing the penitent in the straight path, the 'crossroads' (parashat derakhim) aspect following confession
tmp:1043: ke-she-yotz'in Yisrael me-chokhmatan shel ha-umot — Israel's exodus from the wisdom/philosophy of the nations, whereupon the tzaddik-sun emerges 'like a groom from his chuppah' and shines
tmp:1044: 'be-kan'o et kin'ati' — the verse of Pinchas's zeal (Num. 25:11), signifying the tzaddik who envies no other tzaddik in this world or the next but is zealous only for God alone
tmp:1045: nekudot shel kissufin — the vowel-points formed by one's yearnings/longings ('nikhsefa ve-gam kaltah nafshi'): good or evil desires create good or evil nekudot (souls) that animate the letters
tmp:1046: hitztarfutan shel otiyot ha-Torah — the combining/pairing of the Torah's letters to effect an action, good or evil, determined by the vowel-points born of one's yearnings
tmp:1047: oved Elokim — 'one who serves God' (Mal. 3:18), matched with Ben Zoma who 'gazed and died': the heart inflamed beyond its level by the tzaddik's light unto death
tmp:1049: ha-yotzei mi-da'ato me-chamat aliyah le-ma'alah mi-madregato — one who loses his sanity by ascending above his spiritual level: Ben Azzai's 'gazed and was stricken,' the aspect of 'lo avado' (did not serve Him)
tmp:1051: HaKadosh-Barukh-Hu chomed mi-lemalah lishkon im ha-adam — God's desiring from above to dwell with a person, aroused by truth (emet, acronym of 'amah tekhalenah milemalah'), per 'God is near to all who call on Him in truth'
tmp:1052: HaKadosh-Barukh-Hu oseh al yado mofetim — God's performing miracles/wonders through one who breaks the craving for eating (ta'avat akhilah), linked to 'yisa Hashem panav'
tmp:1053: HaKadosh-Barukh-Hu shokhen imo — God's dwelling with a person as the reward of truth ('God is near to all who call upon Him in truth'), the light one finds at the opening; falsehood drives Him away
tmp:1054: sa'ara be-igula — 'hair in a circle' (Tikkun 70): hairs as circuits/roundabout channels through which the mochin's illumination exits — the circling preliminary explanations leading to the point
tmp:1055: hakdamot ha-mesavevin — the roundabout introductions/preliminaries (of a lower intellect clothing a higher one) that circle until arriving at the intended point (mekhuvan), like hair-circuits
tmp:1056: hakdamot shel kol ha-chokhmot — the premises/axioms of every wisdom, called 'servants' (Pharaoh's avadim) that serve the wisdom, in the Vacated Space (chalal ha-panui) teaching
tmp:1057: osek be-masa u-matan be-emunah — conducting business/commerce in faithfulness, i.e., engaging monetary law (pshat of Torah), equivalent to offering the tamid sacrifice and burning the incense
tmp:1058: hakravat ha-korban tamid ve-haktarat ha-ketoret — the daily tamid offering and incense-burning as cosmic acts (raising ChaBaD of Asiyah into Yetzirah, holy sparks via eleven spices) enacted by honest commerce
tmp:1059: hasagot Elokut — perceptions/apprehensions of Godliness, attainable only via many tzimtzumim (contractions) from cause to effect, higher intellect clothed in lower, like teacher to student
tmp:1062: hashgachah shleimah — complete divine providence, drawn down only after breaking the craving for money through tzedakah (the 'generous spirit' cooling the heart's heat)
tmp:1063: hasagat Elokuto — the comprehension of God's Divinity, the essence of the World to Come ('they will all know Me'), each new attainment prompting teshuvah upon the prior one
